topic: Toji's bounty deadline was bait to make Gojo lower his guard
title: Toji's Bounty Timer Was Built To Bore Gojo
description: Toji Fushiguro put a time limit on the bounty for Riko Amanai, and I think the clock was aimed at Gojo's attention. Hidden Inventory, chapters 67 and 71. Was it a plan or luck?
comment: Was Toji's bounty deadline a real plan to lower Gojo's guard, or did Gojo just get careless? Pick one.
end_text: THE ONE MAN GOJO COULDN'T READ

lines.text: Toji's bounty had a timer, and it was aimed at Gojo.

shot.fallback: scarred man smiling at a glowing countdown screen

lines.text: In chapter 67 Toji posts a bounty on Riko Amanai, the Star Plasma Vessel.

shot.search: Riko Amanai Star Plasma Vessel bounty
shot.fallback: girl in a school uniform with a glowing mark

lines.text: He puts it on a site for curse users, with a time limit.

shot.fallback: dark website with a ticking timer

lines.text: Every sorcerer who chases it loses, and Toji knows they will. That's free labor wearing the escort down.

shot.fallback: two students guarding a girl on a busy street

lines.text: But the clock does something quieter. It tells Gojo when the mission is over.

shot.search: Gojo Riko Amanai Tokyo Jujutsu High
shot.fallback: white haired student relaxing as the sun sets

lines.text: Once the deadline passes, Gojo relaxes, and in chapter 71 he switches Infinity off.
That's the moment Toji steps in. Not a second earlier.

shot.fallback: dark figure stepping behind a relaxed sorcerer

lines.text: The wiki reads that time limit as bait to lower Gojo's guard.

shot.fallback: man watching a target from the shadows

lines.text: Maybe Gojo was just careless. But a deadline is a choice, and Toji chose it.

shot.fallback: calm man placing a chess piece

lines.text: A trap built from other people's greed, with Gojo's own attention as the trigger.

shot.search: Toji Fushiguro trap Star Plasma Vessel
shot.fallback: silhouette in a doorway as a countdown reaches zero

lines.text: And the bigger question is why nobody else ever got that same opening.
Because to Toji, that bounty had a timer, and it was aimed at Gojo.

shot.fallback: scarred man smiling at a clock
